text:
maya: Heads up — FluxCorp reported they received two invoices for Nov. One invoice is missing the GPU/compute line, the other has an extra 'Integration Support' line and the amounts don't add up. invoice ids: inv_202511_4587 and inv_202511_4587-duplicate

ravi: ugh. do we have a quick diff of line items? can you paste the invoice JSON or PDF links?

maya: PDF links: https://billing.redwood.app/invoices/inv_202511_4587.pdf and https://billing.redwood.app/invoices/inv_202511_4587-duplicate.pdf

ops-bot: automated alert: invoice-generator job 2025-11-02T03:12:10Z finished with warnings (code 0x1A). See job logs: https://ci.redwood.app/jobs/2025-11-02-4587

ravi: checking logs now. quick SQL to check invoice_line table: ```sql
SELECT id, invoice_id, description, amount_cents, source_job
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE invoice_id IN ('inv_202511_4587','inv_202511_4587-duplicate')
ORDER BY invoice_id;
```

ravi: ok lines show: for inv_202511_4587 the GPU compute line is NULL (should be ~2,400.00), while inv_202511_4587-duplicate has two "Integration Support" lines (each 150.00) and a full compute line too. looks like merge + partial retry created a dup and a stale record lost the compute line.

maya: customer is escalated. Sara in support pinged them. Sara, can you confirm they haven't paid either?

sara: they haven't paid yet, waiting on our fix. they're worried about double-billing. asked for a statement of corrections.

luis: if we cancel one invoice we need to issue a credit memo. which invoice should be canonical?

ravi: canonical should be inv_202511_4587-duplicate (it has the complete compute + extras). we need to: 1) merge the unique lines into inv_202511_4587-duplicate, 2) void inv_202511_4587, 3) emit a credit for the phantom integration line if overcharged, 4) run reconciliation for customer balance.

maya: timeline? ops-bot showed job warnings at 03:12Z, probable root cause: renderer retried while webhook from usage-collector replayed a partial payload. Ticketing to infra: INF-7892.

ravi: quick mitigation — locking invoicing-runner for FluxCorp and re-running job with --idempotency-key set to invoice_batch_202511_fluxcorp. I'll run a dry-run first.

maya: please post dry-run diff here. Sara, tell customer we expect resolution in ~4 hours, will follow up with corrected invoice + credit memo.

ravi: dry-run diff: ```diff
- invoice inv_202511_4587: -compute line (missing)
+ invoice inv_202511_4587-duplicate: +compute line $2400.00
+ duplicate "Integration Support" line removed (150.00)
```

ravi: re-run started (job 2025-11-02-4587-retry). keeping thread updated.

ops-bot: job 2025-11-02-4587-retry completed successfully. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.app/artifacts/2025-11-02-4587-retry/diff.json

ravi: reconciliation passed. I voided inv_202511_4587 and created credit cr_202511_0007 for the duplicate integration line. Updated ledger reference: LEDG-202511-FLUX-45

luis: thanks. I'll prepare the customer-facing correction and approval email. Maya, can you confirm support message once email is ready?

maya: confirmed. Sara, send the correction and mark customer as 'resolved' after they acknowledge.

sara: will do. adding note to support ticket: FIXED — invoice generator idempotency bug mitigated, credit issued.

ravi: follow-up: opening a postmortem with eng-billing & infra to add stronger idempotency checks and a reconcile-before-issue step. assigning to INF-7892 and BILL-332.

maya: great. closing loop here, thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
